source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the Chassis information and detail information
And Compare FRU data with ipmitool fru print to check if contect correct or not

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Data should be readable and correct.

deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL pretty-printed JSON from /redfish/v1/Chassis/FRU_FE_1 (FRU_FE front chassis/FRU (1..4 analogous)) so user can read/diff against SPEC for "FRU_FE_1~4". No RISK (read-only).

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES checks only FE_1 and assumes FE_2~4 are analogous; it also assumes the URI, bypasses TLS, projects three fields and omits per-member IPMI/WebUI parity.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED requires four-member topology, present/absent rules and complete per-FE reconciliation.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 955/2291 accepts the one-member command despite the explicit FE_1~4 title.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: CPUSLED and FP are distinct FRUs; neither covers the four front-end positions.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 preserves four-member scope, ED-34 bounds overrides, ED-35 forbids FE_1 extrapolation and ED-36 treats topology/reference as readiness.

original_test_intent: Verify FE_1, FE_2, FE_3 and FE_4 individually, including expected absent positions, with correct complete FRU data across WebUI, mapped Redfish members, mapped read-only IPMI records and Project reference.
original_method: Enumerate actual front-end FRUs, bind each of four logical positions to physical, Redfish and IPMI identities, collect complete read-only evidence, normalize fields and compare each slot plus absent behavior without clearing logs or modifying FRU state.
manual_activity: The owner defines fitted FE slots, member/device maps and expected fields. Automated collection covers each mapped slot; the engineer resolves absent/duplicate/UI exceptions and verdict.
safety_requirements: Do not clear logs or write FRU data.
Do not synthesize FE_2~4 URIs or device IDs from FE_1.
Use trusted protected sessions and redact serial/asset values.
Record all four positions independently, distinguishing absent, unsupported and read failure.
Stop on duplicate or ambiguous slot binding without retry-by-guess.
agent_execution_scope: Enumerate complete Chassis members and collect per-FE Redfish/IPMI evidence.
Capture each WebUI detail and normalize required fields.
Compare per position with explicit absent/missing outcomes.
engineer_actions: Approve fitted FE matrix and per-slot mapping.
Approve fields, encodings, redaction and authority.
Review all four slot results and issue verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: FE_1 is at most one-quarter of stated scope; the command assumes identity, weakens TLS and omits complete IPMI/UI comparisons.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Enumerate and map FE_1~4, then collect complete protected per-slot Redfish and IPMI data for WebUI/reference comparison.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Four FE indices, WebUI/ipmitool method, Criterion and 2/0-minute estimates remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a four-position topology-bound FRU parity matrix.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC, schema and IPMI decoder versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor FE topology/FRU layout and Project build record.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exhaustive per-slot discovery, absent rules, security and raw provenance while retaining original interfaces.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: FE_1 evidence cannot represent FE_2~4; API-only evidence does not prove IPMI or WebUI parity.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Four-slot map, device IDs and field expectations.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Numeric IDs may not align across interfaces and unfitted positions may be valid.

project_override_considerations: Alternate collection is allowed only with per-slot target proof, approval, field equivalence and uncovered WebUI/IPMI coverage.
expected_evidence: Per-slot exact Redfish/IPMI mapping and complete raw redacted output
Four WebUI captures and Project reference
Per-FE normalized field matrix with absence/read-error separation
Uncleared logs, no-write proof and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master title, Procedure and Criteria consistently require front-end FRU correctness; DeepSeek's FE_1-only shortcut is not a Master conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Four-member intent is clear; fitted topology and references are readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects one-member extrapolation and restores per-slot IPMI/UI parity.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Independently agrees with hybrid four-slot validation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Corrects direct acceptance of FE_1-only evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Separates FE positions from sled/front-panel FRUs.

review_improvement: Requires an auditable four-position matrix so an absent, duplicated or swapped front-end FRU cannot hide behind one correct FE_1 response.
independent_technical_reasoning: The title is explicitly plural and indexed; a correct FE_1 response provides no evidence for three other positions. Because physical, Redfish and IPMI numbering can differ, each logical FE index needs an authority-backed mapping and independent data row.
